text.en:
Upon finishing a reload within 3.8 seconds of a Kill:
Your next Weapon Hit within 7 seconds applies Jolt. 

Damage from Jolt can be increased through Weapon Damage Increases, Debuffs, and Combatant Rank Modifiers. (The last only works against the Jolted enemy)

enhanced (
#e Buff Duration is increased to 8 seconds.
)
text.zh-chs:
完成武器击杀后 3 秒内进行填装：
7 秒内的下一次武器命中会震颤敌人。

此次震颤的伤害量可以通过其他增益效果提升。

enhanced (
#e 增益持续时间提升为 8 秒。
)

text.en:
Finishing a reload within 3.8 seconds of a Weapon Kill grants Voltshot for #e${7+#d} seconds.

While Voltshot is active, your next Weapon Hit applies <arc/>Jolt and consumes the buff.

#e Buff can be held 1 second longer.
